captions.text: Hey, welcome back!
In this video, we will tackle My Vault mindset
and how to make the most out of it.
My Vault is not a junk drawer for AI text.
It is the memory of your operation.
Every comment pack Gold Rush saves is proof you
ran the play, and a shortcut when life gets busy
and you do not want to regenerate from scratch.
By the end, you will treat packs like assets, not
clutter.
Quick picture.
You already generated at least one comment pack
in Gold Rush.
If you did not, go ahead and watch the previous
videos.
You will get a step -by -step guide on how to do
it.
So, let us continue.
When generation succeeds on Gold Rush, the pack
lands in My Vault automatically.
You did not forget to click Save.
The system did that because your future self will
need a library.
My Vault lives under Library on the sidebar.
Your saved comments.
The page reminds you, Every pack you generate lives
here.
Copy one, open the short, and post.
Belief one.
A pack in the Vault is potential energy.
Posting converts it to kinetic.
Comments sitting uncopied do not send traffic.
Opens and copies on each pack tell you whether
you are revisiting winners or hoarding drafts.
Opens track how many times you expanded the comment
list.
Copies track how many times you grabbed text.
High copies with zero YouTube posts still means
you copied, but only posted comments earn.
The Vault measures your workflow honesty, not commission
directly.
Belief two.
Organize by action, not by perfection.
Each card shows offer name, video title, niche,
comment count, opens, copies, and date.
Do not delete packs because comment two sounded
weird.
Delete when the offer is dead, the link changed
permanently, or the short was a mismatch you will
not touch again.
Keep packs for offers you still promote, even if
you only posted one comment from the set.
Regenerate on Gold Rush when the angle is stale.
Reuse My Vault when you are reposting on a new
short with the same offer.
Belief three.
My Vault is your rehearsal room.
Expanding comments shows numbered lines with copy
on each row.
Open video jumps to the YouTube short so you can
re -listen before you paste.
Treat each pack like a script card.
Pick the line that fits today, tweak one sentence
in your voice, post.
Hide comments when you are done so the list stays
scannable.
Belief four.
Empty Vault means empty habit.
Fix the habit, not the tool.
The empty state walks you through generate, copy,
paste.
If you are watching this mindset video with an
empty vault, your homework is one Gold Rush run
before the next Academy video, not more theory.
Generate new pack on the header sends you back
to Gold Rush when you want fresh shorts, not when
you are avoiding posting what is already copied.
Belief five.
Numbers are feedback, not judgment.
Low opens might mean you never reopened the pack.
Open it tonight.
Low copies might mean you generate but never commit
to one line.
Copy one comment before you close the laptop.
You are building a rhythm.
Generate, vault, view, copy, open video, paste
on YouTube.
Skip a step and the chain breaks quietly.
No error message, just no traffic.
Belief six.
Respect deletion.
Delete this pack is permanent.
Only delete when you are sure.
Wrong offer, toxic short association, or duplicate
you created by accident.
If you are deleting because you are embarrassed
by the wording, regenerate instead, or copy a different
comment from the same pack.
The vault should shrink slowly and on purpose,
not because you rage click after one bad day.
Belief seven.
Link vault and my vault are siblings, not duplicates.
Link vault stores affiliate URLs.
My vault stores comment packs tied to shorts and
offers.
Changing a link in link vault does not rewrite
old comments in saved packs.
Gold Rush baked whatever URL you used at generation
time.
When your vendor gives a new hop link, run a fresh
pack on Gold Rush with the updated URL and let
the new pack sit beside the old one until you retire
the old offer.
One emotional stakes line, because it is true.
The pack you copy tonight might be the one a stranger
reads tomorrow on a short they were already watching.
One link to change their path and also yours if
they buy through you.
My vault keeps that moment from disappearing into
clipboard history.
Three operator habits.
Habit one.
After every Gold Rush generation, open my vault
within five minutes and view comments once, even
if you already copied on the Gold Rush page.
Double check the pack stored correctly.
Habit two.
Once a week, scroll your vault top to bottom and
post one older pack you never used.
Second chance money.
Habit three.
When an offer wins, stick with that name.
Generate more packs for it.
Ignore shiny new offers until you have posted three
comments for the winner.
Your action before my vault training.
If you have packs, open my vault now and pick the
newest one.
View comments, copy one line, open video, and post
if you have not yet.
If the vault is empty, stop this video, run Gold
Rush once, then come back.
Mindset plus motion.
Always motion.
I'll see you in the next one.
